purpose: Planning only; not capture or review evidence
candidateSourceRule: Pin exact final independently reviewed committed SHA before one build; never use dirty worktree or relabel old PNGs
periodDateRule: D = Taipei calendar date frozen at batch start; record resolved UTC bounds; crossing midnight requires re-resolution, never mix fullpage and slices

diskBudget.historicalNote: 22 PNGs are not assigned to these manifest viewport lists; retained unchanged, not attributed to a new SHA or counted as reviewed.
diskBudget.estimatesExclude: Additional interaction images, refreshed tag references and network receipts; not a reservation or execution approval.
diskBudget.batchCeilingScope: Includes PNG and all network/reference/metadata evidence; 12 packages at 6MB + 12MB evidence = 84MB, below 90MB. Three inclusive caps total270MB, below300MB.
diskBudget.rule: Stop before either batch or cumulative cap; do not delete old files or reset cumulative accounting between batches. Rest of matrix remains pending until sufficient explicitly approved budget exists.

captureGates: Explicit thaw covering build/staging/capture/probes; no auto-unfreeze
Global max 2 browsers, max 1 build; pgrep plus actual process inspection before start
Before and after every batch: load<=12; blog totalSeconds<=2, all three sites known non-5xx; timeout/unknown denies
Honor 112.5GiB retained capture floor unless operator explicitly supersedes; require estimated batch space above floor
Independent Playwright DNT=1/GPC; Google/GA/GTM routes installed before first navigation; no synthetic analytics
Bounded redacted network receipt: allowlisted host/category/outcome only, no headers/cookies/query/body/IP/full UA
Record SHA, BUILD_ID, pinned digest and runtime artifact proof separately from manifest assertions
Assert window and data generation before AND after fullpage/slices; drift fails batch; immutable new directory
Existing roles only; isolated nonidentifying mocks for failures/writes; missing role or fixture stays pending
Reviewer independently sees exact images and tag references; source author may not self-review
